en: Ace Trainer Makalii: The mountain looks quiet from here. It's not.
text: Antrenor As Makalii: Muntele pare liniștit de aici. Nu e.

en: Ace Trainer Makalii: It's louder than I thought.
text: Antrenor As Makalii: E mai zgomotos decât credeam.

en: Hiker Akoni: Lanakila is the tallest mountain in Alola. Big mountains, big Pokémon!
text: Drumeț Akoni: Lanakila e cel mai înalt munte din Alola. Munți mari, Pokémoni mari!

en: Hiker Akoni: The mountain wins either way.
Backpacker Keala: I keep a bag of surprises. This team is one.
text: Rucsăcar Keala: Țin un rucsac de surprize. Echipa asta e una.

en: Backpacker Keala: You were the surprise.
text: Rucsăcar Keala: Tu ai fost surpriza.
